para_trans: Regarding administrative approval to the Detailed Project Report (DPR) submitted by the local bodies for the works to be taken up out of the prize money received under Maji Vasundhara Abhiyan 4.0.
Tarkhad Gram Panchayat, District Palghar.
Government of Maharashtra
Department of Environment and Climate Change
Government Decision No: M A 0426 / Q 132 (23) / TAC 1
Martyr Rajguru Chowk, Madam Cama Marg,
Mantralaya, Mumbai 400032
Date: September 7, 2026

Read: (1) Government Decision, Environment and Climate Change Department No. Mission - 2024 / Q. No.66 / T. 1 dated 27th September, 2024 (2) Government Decision, Environment and Climate Change Department No. Abhiyaan-20219 / P.S. No.57 / T. No.1, dated 8th February, 2022 (3) The minutes of the meetings of the Committee constituted for the approval of the Administrator dated 7th April, 2026
The Proposal:

The procedure for the award of cash prizes to the winning local bodies in the 12 categories of Majhi Vasundhara Abhiyan 4.0 and the appropriation of the said prize money has been notified vide Government Decision dated 27.09.2024 at Reference No. (1). Accordingly, a Detailed Project Report of the works to be taken up by the local bodies out of the award amount has been prepared vide Government Decision dated 08.02.2022 at Reference No. Administrative approval has to be obtained from a committee constituted under the chairmanship of Secretary, Department of Environment and Climate Change.

2. Accordingly, for grant of administrative approval to the Detailed Project Report received from the Awardee Local Bodies, Ms. The Committee has made recommendations after discussing the Detailed Project Report submitted by the Dosnt Local Bodies held on 07.04.2026 under the Chairmanship of Secretary, Environment & Climate Change Department. It was under the consideration of the government to grant administrative approval to the Detailed Project Report of the respective local bodies as recommended by the committee.
The government's decision:

Considering the points mentioned in the proposal, the detailed project report of the works to be taken up out of the total prize money of Rs. 25.00 lakh to be received by Tarkhad Gram Panchayat under Maji Vasundhara Abhiyan 4.0 has been submitted by the Village Development Officer, Tarkhad Gram Panchayat with the technical approval of the Executive Engineer, Zilla Parishad Palghar. The proposal was submitted by the Tarkhad Gram Panchayat. Committee constituted under the Chairmanship of Secretary, Department of Environment & Climate Change dated 07.04.2026
Government Decision No: MAWA 0426 / P.S. 132 (23) / T. A. 1.

It was discussed at the meeting. As per the recommendation made by the said Committee, the works in the Detailed Project Report submitted by Tarakhad Gram Panchayat for a total cost of Rs.25,01, 315.00 (Rupees Twenty Five Lakhs One Thousand Three Hundred and Fifteen Only) are being accorded administrative sanction by the Government subject to the following terms and conditions.
The works for which administrative approval is being granted are shown in the accompanying Annexure-9.
2. Terms and Conditions 1) The working mechanism for the works in this Detailed Project Report shall be the Tarkhad Gram Panchayat.

2) The financial and physical progress report of the implementation of the works mentioned in this Detailed Project Report should be sent to my Vasundhara Mission Directorate by the 5th of every month.
3) The implementation of the works in this Detailed Project Report should be completed within the next 6 months from the approval of the Administrator.
4) If the amount of the prize exceeds the amount, it should be made out of self-funding.
5) In case of any increase in the original project cost in this Detailed Project Report for any reason, no additional funds / grants will be made available for the same.

3. Tarkhar Gram Panchayat has received a prize of Rs. 25.00 lakhs for high jump in the "Gram Panchayat Group (population 1.5-5.5 thousand)" category in My Vasundhara Abhiyan 4.0. Out of this, 50 per cent i.e. Rs. 12.50 lakh has been disbursed to them. Since the detailed project report of the works to be taken out of this prize money has been granted administrative approval by the Government as per paragraphs 1 and 2 above, the Government is approving the distribution of the second instalment of the remaining prize money of Rs. 12.50 lakh (Rupees twelve lakh fifty thousand only) to the Tarakhad Gram Panchayat through the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board.
4 These Government Decisions are available on the website of the Government of Maharashtra www.maharashtra.gov.in
